text:
anya: quick heads-up — started bring-up for draft-model path using speculative decoding on llama3-70b-quant. initial perf looks promising but there are quality quirks.

matt: nice. top-line numbers?

anya: throughput up ~1.6x on our long-form generation workload (batching steady). token p50 dropped from ~18ms to ~11ms with drafts=2.

devin: that matches what we saw in small sims. what's the eval delta?

anya: rouge-L on long_summ dev set down ~1.8 pts, factuality (QA exact match) worse by ~3% on multi-hop items. short prompts (chat style) almost identical.

sara: any failure modes observed? hallucinations, truncation?

anya: two recurring patterns: 1) speculative sometimes picks draft completions that bias style away from concise summaries -> more verbose; 2) rare inconsistent facts when draft model (llama3-12b-quant) proposes a continuation that the main model accepts.

matt: can you paste the current spec config?

anya:```
speculative:
  drafts: 2
  draft_model: llama3-12b-quant
  accept_threshold: 0.62
  reranker: rerank-small-v1
  max_tokens_draft: 128
  fallback_on_mismatch: true
```

anya: and run command I used: `./bench/run_eval.sh --model draft-70b-quant --eval long_summ --spec-drafts 2 --rerank rerank-small-v1 --seed 42`

devin: do we log draft vs final token sources for analysis?

anya: yes — added a lightweight trace CSV (request_id, token_idx, chosen_source). sharing sample in #eng-ml-uploads.

matt: suggested ablations:
- drafts=1/2/3
- accept_threshold sweep [0.5,0.6,0.7]
- rerank on top-k vs no-rerank
- use non-quantized draft (12b-fp16) to see if quantization of draft is causing weird proposals

anya: +1 on the fp16 check. I suspect draft quant artifacts cause hallucination seeds.

sara: can we also run a small human eval for factuality on the top 200 examples where draft source != final source? quick A/B with crowd?

anya: already queued with evaluation ops — will sample 200 and run 3-judge consensus.

devin: from infra side — if we increase drafts to 3 we need to reserve additional concurrency for the draft pool. I can spin a canary in Dedicated with a soft cap. deploy-bot: canary request queued.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled to cluster-dedicated-2 at 2026-04-07T14:00Z, config: drafts=3, draft_model=llama3-12b-quant, traffic=5%.

matt: for automatic rerank, are we using embedding-based re-ranking or shallow logprob compare?

anya: currently embedding + small LM score hybrid. quick formula: score = 0.6*embed_sim + 0.4*norm_lp. will try pure logprob in ablation too.

matt: would be useful to add a targeted eval: extract factual claims (ner + relation) and check against KB — that isolates hallucination regressions vs verbosity.

anya: good call. i'll add an extractor pass and run on ~1k dev items. expected extra time ~6h on cluster.

devin: one more engineering note — enable `fallback_on_mismatch=true` for canary so we don't commit when mismatch rate > 15%.

anya: set that flag locally. also instrument a metric: `speculative.mismatch_rate` and `speculative.draft_accept_rate` per route.

sara: timeline? when do we expect a follow-up?

anya: i'll run the ablation sweep (drafts x thresholds x rerank) overnight. plan to post aggregated numbers + sampled failure cases tomorrow morning. will also start the 200-judge HITs once results narrow.

matt: great. if ablation shows small-quality reg with big cost wins we should consider hybrid: enable spec for latency-sensitive routes only and keep others on baseline.

anya: agreed. action items:
- anya: sweep and post metrics + 20 representative failure snippets (tomorrow AM)
- devin: configure canary for drafts=3, fallback threshold, extra concurrency (today)
- sara: queue human eval for 200 examples (tomorrow)
- matt: prep KB-backed extractor and run on 1k items (start now)

anya: tagging @devex to update docs if we adopt per-route enablement. :thumbsup:

devin: noted. thanks all.

anya: thanks — will update thread with results.
